name: Retell AI
pricing_notes: Pay-as-you-go $0.07–$0.31/min depending on LLM/voice/telephony. Voice infra $0.055/min. 20 concurrent calls free, then $8/concurrency/month. Phone numbers $2/month. Enterprise: custom.
free_tier: Yes – $0 to start, pay per minute
best_for: Developers and agencies wanting pay-as-you-go voice agents with no platform fee

name: Vapi
pricing_notes: Pre-paid $0.05/min hosting; transcriber, model and voice providers billed at cost; $5 free credits. Pro package: 10% of hosting fee, $999/mo minimum. Core and Premier packages also listed.
features: Bring your own models (transcriber, LLM, voice)
best_for: Engineering teams that want fine control over every model in the voice stack

name: Bland AI
pricing_notes: Start: $0.14/min, $0 platform fee, 10 concurrent calls, 100 calls/day. Build: $0.12/min + $299/month. Enterprise: custom. Per-minute rate includes LLM, STT and TTS.
free_tier: Start plan: 2 credits + inbound number, no card required
best_for: Teams wanting one predictable per-minute rate without token pass-throughs

name: Synthflow
pricing_notes: Pricing page lists enterprise contracts starting at $30,000 annually, scoped by volume, concurrency, telephony and integrations.
features: Custom routing, handoffs and fallback logic
CRM, calendar, contact-center and API integrations
best_for: Mid-market and enterprise contact centers wanting a managed deployment

name: ElevenLabs Agents
pricing_notes: Shared credit plans per FAQ: Free $0, Starter $6, Creator $22, Pro $99, Scale $299, Business $990, Enterprise custom. Agent-specific per-minute pricing was not shown on the page we checked.
best_for: Builders who prioritise voice quality and already use ElevenLabs

name: Goodcall
pricing_notes: Starter $79/mo (100 unique customers, then 79¢); Growth $129/mo (500, then 26¢); Scale $299/mo (2,000, then 15¢). No per-minute charges. Local number included.
features: External tools: API, MCP server, code
best_for: Small service businesses that want a predictable monthly bill

name: Rosie
pricing_notes: Professional $49/mo (250 min); Scale $149/mo (1,000 min); Growth $299/mo (2,000 min). Annual billing: 2 months free. 7-day free trial.
best_for: Solo owners and home-service businesses that need a no-code AI receptionist
affiliate: Affiliate program mentioned on site; terms not verified

name: Dialora
pricing_notes: Pricing not published on the homepage we checked.
features: Industry templates, trained on your docs
best_for: Small businesses and agencies running outbound lead follow-up
